value.rationale: The exact occupied image of a canonical second-kind Pell–Lucas recurrence modulo every power of 2 is a natural complete local arithmetic invariant. It strengthens the previously known non-residue-completeness with three structurally distinct isometric/quadratic branches, all image cardinalities, and a sharp \(9/64\) Haar support measure; it is not an arbitrary finite slice or a routine change of notation.
